role: Check if the app is running in development or production mode via build-time env variable
detail: Exports a single React hook useDevMode() that returns a boolean. Reads VITE_APP_MODE from Vite's import.meta.env at runtime (set at build time). Returns true if VITE_APP_MODE is not exactly 'production', false otherwise. Used to conditionally enable dev-only features and UI. No side effects; pure boolean derivation from environment.
gotchas: Relies on Vite build-time env injection; any typo in VITE_APP_MODE or unexpected value will incorrectly enable dev mode. No fallback if env is undefined.
